certification_boundary: This evidence promotes one internal five-seat Agent 201 workshop on Arena. It does not certify public-code access, external DNS/TLS, or 25-seat Agent 201 performance.

test_runs.live_arena_workshop: 5 seats ready; each completed an error-free model and three-tool agent journey
test_runs.live_arena_cleanup: zero namespaces, Routes, Applications, and RoleBindings

red: The catalog contract rejected max_workshop_seats=1 when the five-seat gate was opened.
The first candidate rendered literal %maas_url% and %litellm_api_key% values; model calls returned masked connection-error fallbacks.
A chained Antora alias attempt remained literal because the Showroom userdata replacement is single pass.
The ownership contract showed provisioning plans lacked the persisted session UUID and namespaces mislabeled request UUIDs as session IDs.
Five simultaneous Agent journeys on granite-2b-cpu all exceeded the 300-second Route timeout.
The model-selection contract rejected granite-2b-cpu before the catalog moved to the workshop-certified tool model.
The evidence contract failed with FileNotFoundError before this manifest existed.
green: Direct maas_endpoint and maas_api_key attributes render into all five guides from content v1.0.7.
Every new namespace carries distinct session-id and request-id labels with the persisted session UUID.
The catalog selects granite-3.2-8b-tools for Agent 201.
Five concurrent journeys completed with structured briefs, all three MCP tools, and no inference errors.
Bulk reclaim removed every workshop artifact.

bdd.scenario: Given one five-seat Agent 201 order targeted to Arena, when each participant follows the rendered guide, then every isolated seat deploys the tools, agent, and UI, receives a structured solution brief using all three MCP tools and real model inference, and one bulk reclaim removes the workshop.
